metadata.title: Generic Identifiability and Directed Containment for Strongly Tree-Child Level-2 Networks under the Kimura Two-Parameter Model: The Principal Positive Domain and Strict Continuous Time
metadata.archive_revision_note: r1 supporting package revision; no inferred change of theorem or PDF text

claim_interfaces.label: Theorem 7.3
claim_interfaces.claim: Source-relative analytic regular full-dimensional containment on D+ iff ordinary-triangle structural equivalence iff common full-dimensional regular germ. No proper one-sided containment.

claim_interfaces.label: Theorem 8.1
claim_interfaces.claim: For each fixed permitted network, generic structural triangle-class identifiability outside a proper algebraic exceptional set.

claim_interfaces.label: Theorem 9.1
claim_interfaces.claim: Finite exact reconstruction with effective field operations, exact sign/real-closed-field decisions; O(n^9) restriction count, not total bit complexity.

claim_interfaces.label: Corollary 10.1
claim_interfaces.claim: Same conclusions on strict continuous-time DCT.

claim_interfaces.label: Theorem 11.1
claim_interfaces.claim: For each n>=3 a pair of weak-not-strong nonisomorphic non-triangle-equivalent level-two networks share a strict CT regular 4n-3 germ.

assumptions: finite common labelled leaf set; binary rooted admissible graphs, root lowest stable ancestor; simple standard one-step root suppression preserving reticulation arrowheads
strong tree-childness means every admissible rooting is tree-child; level at most two
uniform K2P root and independent reticulation switching; edge spectrum (1,s,g,s) with equal C/T sector
ordinary triangle redirection only for a three-cycle factor with exactly three external arms; coherent labelled transports
containment uses regular source image/full source dimension and an analytic physical target section
excluded_claims: all weakly tree-child networks are ambiguous
polynomial total runtime or bit complexity
independent human review or novelty certification
load_bearing_computation: four-port directed universe, exact rank upper/lower certificates and polynomial separators
five-port theta2 universe and dummy restoration
all-site one-/two-port probes and coherent word recovery
